The AI tool is in health, which this study excludes.

facts.fact: Ghana Health Service and Jacaranda Health launched the AI-powered PROMPTS (Nurse Mary) maternal health platform, which sorts mothers' SMS questions by urgency and refers emergencies to facilities, with over 7,000 mothers enrolled at Greater Accra Regional Hospital.

systems.owner: Ghana Health Service with Jacaranda Health

GHA.note: Developed by Jacaranda Health in Kenya; no local build stated.
